steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Nature vs nurture: nature argues behaviour is determined by inherited genes and biology; nurture argues behaviour is determined by experience and environment. Modern view: interactionism - both contribute. Epigenetics shows environmental factors can switch genes on/off, demonstrating that nature and nurture interact. | Key Fact: Free will vs determinism: free will argues people have conscious control over their choices; determinism argues behaviour is caused by factors beyond our control. Biological determinism (genes/neurochemistry), environmental determinism (conditioning), and psychic determinism (unconscious drives).
